520	King Saul has mercy on Agag. Having mercy on the cruel is a Jewish trait, it's our problem in every generation, that we have mercy
521	on the cruel.
522	We think our enemies are like us, that they're nice.
523	They probably just want to gain something, that's how our minds work.
524	We don't understand that we are dealing with beasts.
525	Why?
526	Because we judge the enemy by ourselves.
527	But to be the king of Israel, you have to understand the gentile.
528	You have to know who the enemy standing in front of you is.
529	Without mercy, without inhibitions, wiping out Amalek, from child to infant.
530	That's why the king of Israel must come with a bit of a mixture in him, a bit of goyishkeit.
531	A bit of their genes, so that he understands them, knows how to look at them, understands a little how the gentile
532	thinks, how the enemy thinks, not only how he himself thinks.
533	Very bold things that the Shem MiShmuel says.
534	But it's broader than that, and it's already written in the Zohar and in many books.
535	The truth is that this is the whole way David HaMelech came into the world: three times, three
536	women take the initiative and do illegal acts, how shall we put it, non-
537	normative acts, in order to bring the next generation.
538	Who are the three women?
539	The first is the elder daughter of Lot, the second is Tamar, who sits at the entrance of Einayim,
540	lies in wait for Yehudah until he comes down the road, and then Peretz is born, the grandfather of Boaz, as we spoke on the eve of Shavuot,
541	and the third is Rut herself.
542	As we said, why on earth would Boaz take her, a poor woman, barefoot, why on earth would
543	a convert take her?
544	She waits for him at the threshing floor and lies at his feet, and he is in the middle of work, and his wife had just died the day before.
545	Women who do things almost by force, in order to advance, to bring into the world our Mashiach.
546	Why is it like this?
547	It's written in the Zohar, in many books of all generations, the same idea.
548	To bring a great soul into the world, you have to cover it with garbage.
549	You have to cover it with refuse, so that the kelipot will allow this soul to arrive.
550	When you want to smuggle goods, how do you smuggle them?
551	Not in diamond wrapping.
552	In what do you smuggle them?
553	In sand, in garbage, to confuse the guards at the border.
554	To bring into the world the soul of David HaMelech, this soul that will change, that will bring the world to its repair, it can't
555	work in a straight way.
556	You need the kelipot to have their eyes covered, you need to confuse them.
557	So what does HaKadosh Baruch Hu do?
558	He stirs up such frightening events that the kelipot celebrate and say "Baruch HaShem," and they don't know that inside
